roleResponsibilities.intro: Platform roles live on three layers: SystemRole (platform: ADMIN / USER), WorkspaceRole (role inside a company), and per-member capabilities can_sell / can_buy. See ADR-0002 for the canonical reference.
roleResponsibilities.escalation: Escalation: employee → company OWNER → Platform Admin → Platform Engineer. Don't escalate to the engineer before checking the React Admin loop (KYC, subscriptions, role applications).

platformEngineer.title: Platform Engineer (is_superuser)
platformEngineer.summary: Technical owner. Works via Django Unfold (/admin/) and terminal. Superuser bypasses every commercial check — DBA escape hatch.
does: Deployment, DB migrations, Celery Beat schedule
Master data CRUD: currencies, countries, units, DeliveryBasis, WorkspaceRole
Assigning SystemRole ADMIN / USER via Django shell or React Admin
Emergency data fixes via Unfold (temporarily removing ReadOnlyInspectionMixin)
Seed: init_superadmin, core_seed
Viewing ActivityLog, QuoteItemHistory, pghistory
platformEngineer.doesNot: Does not work with clients, deals, contracts — that's the domain of commercial company staff.

platformAdmin.title: Platform Admin (SystemRole.ADMIN)
platformAdmin.summary: Moderates the platform: users, companies, KYC, subscriptions, role applications. Invariant: cannot be a CompanyMember — admins have no commercial stake in any deal. Works in PlatformAdminShell inside the SPA.
does: Users: create, edit, change SystemRole, toggle-active, delete
Companies: registry, edit details, invite members into other companies
KYC verification: L1→L2→L3, revoke
SELLER / MANUFACTURER subscriptions: create, activate, suspend, renew, record payment
Role applications SUPPLIER / MANUFACTURER: approve / reject
Force-change Deal stage / Force-approve Quote / Force-cancel Contract (reason required, audit-logged with [FORCE_ADMIN])
SystemSettings: VAT / margin / exchange rate / maintenance / 2FA
platformAdmin.doesNot: Does not perform technical deploy / migrations. Cannot become a CompanyMember. Does not buy, sell, sign or pay on behalf of any company — backend refuses with ADMIN_VIEWER_CANNOT_ACT.

supplierTeam.title: SUPPLIER / MANUFACTURER team (WorkspaceRoles inside the seller company)
supplierTeam.summary: SystemRole is USER for everyone. Actual rights come from WorkspaceRole + can_sell / can_buy. Requires an operational subscription (TRIAL or ACTIVE).
does: OWNER — runs the team, distributes can_sell / can_buy, pays the subscription, invites team members
SALES_MANAGER — submits SupplierBid, builds and sends Quote, signs Contract, client chat, sales analytics (only if can_sell)
LOGIST — manages Fulfillment after CLOSED_WON (shipment, tracking)
CONTRACT_MANAGER (MANUFACTURER) — signs manufacturer contracts, owns the contract flow
FOREIGN_TRADE_SPECIALIST (MANUFACTURER) — foreign trade and export documentation
supplierTeam.doesNot: Does not touch other companies. Does not moderate the platform. Does not perform buyer-side actions on behalf of a CLIENT.

clientTeam.title: CLIENT team (WorkspaceRoles inside the buyer company)
clientTeam.summary: SystemRole is USER for everyone. No subscription required — any KYC-verified CLIENT can buy.
does: OWNER — company profile, KYC, invites, capabilities
PROCUREMENT_MANAGER — creates RFQs, imports Excel requests, evaluates SupplierBid (if can_buy)
BUYER_MANAGER — runs deals, chats with sellers, records payments, accepts Fulfillment deliveries
clientTeam.doesNot: Does not see or interfere with other companies. Does not perform seller-side operations (submit bid, offer CRUD).

faq.howRegisterAnswer: Fill out the registration form, select your company status (Buyer, Seller, or Manufacturer) and wait for administrator confirmation. Verification usually takes 1-2 business days.
faq.howAddEmployeesAnswer: Go to Settings > Users. Click 'Add user', enter email and role (Manager or Employee). An invitation will be sent to their email.
faq.howSwitchStatusAnswer: Use the toggle in the left sidebar. Each status has its own set of features and navigation adapted to your tasks.
faq.howCreateRequest: How to create a purchase request?
faq.howCreateRequestAnswer: Go to the Catalog, select the products you need and click 'Add to request'. Or import a list from Excel via the 'Excel Import' section. Smart Match will automatically find matches in the catalog.
faq.excelFormatsAnswer: Files in .xlsx and .xls formats are supported. The table must contain columns: Name, SKU (or GOST), Quantity, Unit of Measure. XLSX is recommended for best compatibility.
faq.whatIsSmartMatchAnswer: Smart Match is an automatic matching algorithm for Excel items against the catalog. It searches by SKU, GOST, name and equipment group, returning results: Found, Partial, Not Found.
faq.howLandedCostAnswer: FCA Base Price + DAP Logistics (8%) + Customs Duty (5%) = Landed Cost. Then: Landed Cost x (1 + Margin%) = Price excl. VAT x 1.12 = Total incl. VAT (12% Uzbekistan).
faq.canEditSentQuote: Can I edit a sent quote?
faq.canEditSentQuoteAnswer: Yes, but this will create a new version (v2, v3...). Old versions are kept in the archive for audit. The client will see the latest version.
faq.howRequestDiscountAnswer: When viewing a quote, click 'Request discount', enter the desired percentage and comment. The seller will receive a notification and can recalculate the quote.
faq.whatRolesAnswer: Administrator — full access and management. Manager — business operations: deals, procurement, quotes. Employee — limited view.
faq.howResetPasswordAnswer: Click 'Forgot password?' on the login page. A recovery link will be sent to your registered email.
